title: Bound the stateDiff alignment POST with a timeout so a stalled request cannot leave a tab ignoring diffs
outcome: Bound the stateDiff alignment POST with a timeout so a stalled request cannot leave a tab ignoring diffs
acceptance: The client's POST /api/events/full-state request is bounded (for example by AbortSignal.timeout). On timeout it takes the existing failed path: it clears the pending alignment and falls back to requestStateResync. A deterministic test with fake timers covers a stalled request.
